name: Eventilla Events
author: eventilla

sections.description:
Eventilla is SaaS based event management software available from www.eventilla.com/en/. It can be used to publish event landing pages, sending event invites, gathering registrations and selling tickets. Event manager has easy to use tools and comprehensive reports, surveys and all the features needed to run succesfull events. We also offer free mobile app to scan tickets with QR-codes.

You can show Eventilla events on your WordPress site either as a single event or as a list of events. Shortcode and Block Editor is supported.

Event lists can be filtered with tags added in Eventilla.

Because events are saved as custom posts, it is possible to query the posts with a custom wp-query.

Scheduling with Action Scheduler

Since 1.9.0 the plugin handles event updates via Action Scheduler. This means you can process your updates with WP-CLI.

Logging

Since 2.0.0 the plugin has its internal logging system that can be enabled in the settings. If something seems fishy, enable the logging in debug-level. This helps support team to take care of problems that might arise.
Remember to turn of the debug-level after problems have been fixed to avoid unnecessary logging!
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload /eventilla-events/ directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Fill in the Eventilla API key and Account ID.
  4. Use events in content with shorcodes or add Eventilla blocks on a page or a post.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin support multiple tickets?

Not at the moment but this is a planned feature in the future.

Does plugin support registering to the events?

It supports registering for unpaid events. For paid events users must use the event landing page in Eventilla.

2.3.1

  • Fix: an event with several description tabs no longer gets an empty title or another tab’s text. On update the plugin re-fetches, in the background, every event synced since 2.3.0, then once a day, for up to a week, any event still missing its title

2.3.0

  • Feature: per-organization API tokens. On update the plugin exchanges the existing API key and Account ID for organization tokens in the background; no action is needed
  • Feature: “Organization API tokens” table on the settings page. Switching an organization off stops its events from updating
  • Change: events are fetched from the new Eventilla API
  • Feature: an admin notice is shown if the token exchange fails or no organization tokens exist; the sync waits until tokens exist
  • Change: rate-limited event updates are retried automatically with backoff
  • Fix: event languages and the social media description are now stored in event post meta
  • Fix: Finnish translations now load (translation files renamed to the eventilla-events text domain)
  • Change: deactivation now unschedules all plugin background actions
  • Fix: with Polylang, event lists and single events show only the current language’s version
  • Change: with Polylang, existing events must be re-fetched once in the configured languages. An admin notice links to Settings, where an admin runs the migration
  • Fix: “Register now” in the event list no longer throws a TypeError. The link opens the inline form when one exists and otherwise goes to the event page. This now also applies on Finnish and Swedish sites, where the link always went to the event page before
  • Fix: the inline registration form is no longer stripped from the event list output
  • Change: the event list link now carries a data-eventilla-uid attribute. Custom templates get it automatically
  • Fix: in the table view the inline form now opens under its event, not above the table
  • Fix: the event list no longer renders an inline form for paid tickets. Their link goes to the event page, as documented
  • Fix: Cancel in the inline form now closes the whole form box
  • Fix: clicking “Register now” again closes the open inline form
  • Fix: the date columns in the admin event list no longer crash on PHP 8 when an event has a missing or malformed date
  • Fix: with “Allowed tags” and “Require all tags” on, the hourly clean-up no longer deletes every event; it removes only events missing a required tag
  • Fix: Restart processing works again, and the sync restarts right after Restart processing, Continue and Delete ALL events
  • Fix: pausing stops the sync, and saving settings while paused keeps it paused
  • Fix: a changed Interval takes effect immediately
  • Fix: the Tools page works on sites with plain permalinks or WordPress in a subdirectory
  • Fix: with Polylang, updates from Tools, Import event ID and the Update endpoint refresh every language version
  • Fix: [eventillalist show_past=”true”] lists ended events under “Past events” instead of repeating upcoming events
  • Fix: [eventilla uid=”…”] no longer shows cancelled events
  • Fix: the hourly existence check no longer skips events after deleting some
  • Fix: the sync status box counts Polylang update jobs
  • Fix: tags, datafields and the featured image removed in Eventilla are removed from the post on the next update
  • Fix: an event’s post date no longer changes on every sync
  • Fix: the Eventilla logo on the settings page is included in the plugin package
  • Feature: Swedish translation
  • Change: Finnish translation updated for the new messages
  • Feature: the legacy API address can be overridden with the EVENTILLA_WP_LEGACY_API_URL constant or the eventilla_opt_legacy_api_url option
  • Fix: the Tools page, the organization token table and the event blocks are now translated. The Tools page also picks up WordPress.org language packs
  • Fix: the registration form texts and messages (Personal information, Continue, Cancel, the confirmation message) are now translatable
